FORTUNE KINGO (K457): From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages. Over the concluding stages shifted in under pressure and approaching the finish made contact with WINDICATOR FAMILY when being corrected by its rider. Sent for sampling post-race.
ONLY U (J037): Bumped on jumping. WINDICATOR FAMILY (H419): Approaching the winning post became unbalanced when crowded between ONLY U and FORTUNE KINGO. K Teetan stated that from his wide barrier he was instructed to ride the horse in a midfield position if possible. Trainer W K Mo confirmed the instructions issued.
HEALTHY PONY (L046): Shifted out at the start and made contact with ONLY U.
APOLAR FIGHTER (J169): From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages. Held up between the 300 Metres and 100 Metres. AMO ERGO SUM (K394): Jumped awkwardly, shifted out slightly and made contact with CIRCUIT CENTURY. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
TO INFINITY (G277): Jumped only fairly. Near the 300 Metres improved to the inside of AMO ERGO SUM (S Osborne) which shifted in. S Osborne was advised in similar circumstances to exercise more care.
CIRCUIT CENTURY (K308): Shortly after the start made contact with AMO ERGO SUM which shifted out slightly. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea. Before being allowed to race again, CIRCUIT CENTURY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
NOBLE FANS (K038): Shortly after the start shifted in after making contact with WINNING NOW. Sent for sampling post-race.
LAKESHORE HERO (J288): From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages. Sent for sampling post-race.
CHILL MASTER (J319): Shortly after the start was checked when crowded between RUSSET GLOW and FREE PONY which was taken out by KING ALLOY (R Kingscote) which shifted out. R Kingscote was advised to exercise more care.
MAJESTIC DELIGHT (K189): In the middle stages raced keenly and for some distance after the 500 Metres was steadied to avoid WINNING NOW. Held up for clear running between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres and near the 200 Metres was shifted to the inside of BEAUTY GEMINI to obtain clear running.
RUSSET GLOW (L059): Shortly after the start was checked when crowded between CHILL MASTER which was taken out and NOBLE FANS which shifted in after making contact with WINNING NOW. Approaching the 1000 Metres was eased to avoid LAKESHORE HERO which shifted in. Between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres had some difficulty obtaining clear running.
KING ALLOY (K099): Lay out over the final 200 Metres and near the 150 Metres shifted out and made contact with WINNING NOW.
WINNING NOW (K532): Bumped shortly after the start. Bumped near the 150 Metres.
BLUE BARON (J448): Near the 200 Metres was hampered when taken in by MAJESTIC DELIGHT. BLUE BARON then shifted in, resulting in its rider H T Mo having to correct his mount. H T Mo stated that his mount lay in throughout the event and after being taken in near the 200 Metres finished the race off only fairly. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FREE PONY (K229): Shortly after the start was crowded by KING ALLOY which shifted out. Near the 200 Metres was steadied when crowded by BLUE BARON (H T Mo) which, after being taken in by MAJESTIC DELIGHT (C L Chau), then shifted in and away from MAJESTIC DELIGHT when being corrected by Jockey Mo. C L Chau was advised to exercise more care and to ensure there is sufficient room to improve. Held up on the Home Turn. J Orman reported that after being crowded near the 200 Metres his mount was unable to finish its race off as a result of the interference. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BEAUTY GEMINI (L129): A Badel stated that his mount was able to lead the event but failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight and was disappointing. He added that his mount may not have been suited by the early stages being run slightly inside of standard time. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
NEW POWER (H325): Bumped at the start. Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event. Sent for sampling post-race.
LUCKY MCQUEEN (K064): Blundered on jumping, shifted out and made contact with NEW POWER. From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages. Sent for sampling post-race.
IRON SECURITY (L174): Noted to have lost its right hind plate after the race.
ARGENTO OCEAN (K322): Near the 900 Metres ARGENTO OCEAN and its rider B Avdulla became badly unbalanced when bumped heavily by PRIVATE WEALTH which shifted out when racing keenly. As a result ARGENTO OCEAN was then turned in towards PRIVATE WEALTH and again made contact with PRIVATE WEALTH. Near the 550 Metres became unbalanced when it made contact with SILVER BLAZE due to both runners shifting ground. Approaching the finish could not be fully ridden out when positioned tight to the inside of NEW POWER which shifted in.
CALIFORNIA BAY (K364): Jumped awkwardly and shortly after the start made contact with PRIVATE WEALTH. Near the 800 Metres shifted out when being steadied to avoid PRIVATE WEALTH. In the middle stages raced keenly.
LEGEND STAR (K271): Near the 800 Metres was steadied when crowded between NEW POWER and CALIFORNIA BAY which shifted out when being steadied to avoid PRIVATE WEALTH. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PRIVATE WEALTH (L177): Bumped shortly after the start. After being crossed by ARGENTO OCEAN near the 1100 Metres commenced to race keenly. As a result PRIVATE WEALTH improved to the inside of ARGENTO OCEAN and then was checked when left without sufficient room. PRIVATE WEALTH then continued to race keenly throughout the early stages and near the 900 Metres, when racing keenly, shifted out and made contact with ARGENTO OCEAN. As a result ARGENTO OCEAN and its rider B Avdulla became unbalanced, resulting in ARGENTO OCEAN shifting in and crowding the running of PRIVATE WEALTH. A warning was placed on the racing manners of PRIVATE WEALTH. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
COLOURFUL GOLD (L324): Jumped only fairly. From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
SILVER BLAZE (L164): Near the 550 Metres became unbalanced when it made contact with ARGENTO OCEAN due to both runners shifting ground.
SPEEDY PATCH (L104): Was a late withdrawal acting on veterinary advice after sustaining wounds to both hind legs whilst being fractious when being loaded to be transported to Happy Valley. Before being allowed to race again, SPEEDY PATCH will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
FLYING BOOM (K327): Prior to the running of the event Trainer C W Chang advised the horse would be ridden in a conservative manner in the early stages from the outside barrier. From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages. When questioned regarding his riding in the Home Straight K Teetan stated that after settling back in the field, when JUMBO STEPS shifted out entering the Home Straight he improved to that runner’s inside with a view to following the favourite AMAZING GAZE. He said his decision to do so was influenced by the fact that he was of the opinion AMAZING GAZE was improving into the race. He said when AMAZING GAZE did not quicken as he had expected, a run then developed to the inside of AMAZING GAZE when GOLDEN BRILLIANT shifted in. He said as a result he then steadied his mount and shifted to the inside of AMAZING GAZE to secure clear running near the 200 Metres. Sent for sampling post-race.
KINGMAN REEF (L446): From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
JUMBO STEPS (L269): Prior to the running of the event Trainer P C Ng confirmed that from a wide barrier he had instructed for the horse to be ridden in a conservative manner in the early stages to offset the wide barrier. From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages. Held up for clear running making the Home Turn.
GOLDEN BRILLIANT (K347): A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SEA CHARIOT (K358): Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VECU (L027): A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CIRCUIT FIERY (H475): When giving ground near the 100 Metres was steadied to avoid VECU which shifted out and away from GLORIOUS DYNASTY. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GOLDEN ACE (L461): Made contact with a rail on entering the Parade Ring, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race. On jumping was bumped by TAKE ACTION which shifted in. Approaching the 1400 Metres was steadied when crowded by AKERMANIS GOLD which was taken in by SURE JOYFUL (Apprentice H Y Yuen) which shifted in before being corrected. Apprentice Yuen was reprimanded.
ROAD TO GLORY (L415): Prior to the running of the event Trainer J Richards advised that from a wide barrier he had instructed Z Purton to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages. On jumping became unbalanced when it made contact with URANUS STAR and then from a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
SURE JOYFUL (G125): Prior to the running of the event Trainer P F Yiu advised that he had instructed Apprentice H Y Yuen to hold an on-pace position but not necessarily lead. Apprentice Yuen could offer no excuse for her mount’s disappointing performance. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GENERAL REDWOOD (L102): Jumped awkwardly. E C W Wong stated that he was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages. He said when unable to obtain cover GENERAL REDWOOD was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event. Trainer C S Shum confirmed the instructions issued.
TAKE ACTION (J098): Shifted in on jumping and was bumped. S Osborne could offer no excuse for the horse’s failure to run on in the Home Straight. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
STEADFAST FORT (L286): From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
JOLLY BONUS (L327): Jumped only fairly. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
INVICTUS (L277): Near the 800 Metres shifted in towards COUNTRY PRIDE and was steadied. Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
FLOW RIDER (M012): On jumping made contact with CLOUD NINE due to both runners shifting ground. After traveling a short distance FLOW RIDER was then eased to avoid CLOUD NINE when CLOUD NINE was taken out by INVICTUS.
CLOUD NINE (L050): Prior to the running of the event Trainer M Newnham advised that the horse would be ridden in a conservative manner in the early stages. He said he issued those instructions as CLOUD NINE had not been finishing its races off strongly when ridden forward at its most recent starts. Shortly after the start made contact with FLOW RIDER due to both runners shifting ground. Raced keenly in the early stages. Sent for sampling post-race.
MR INVINCIBLE (L448): Bumped near the 1000 Metres. Lay in when under pressure in the Home Straight.
THUNDER PRINCE (K017): Making the Home Turn was held up for clear running. Near the 350 Metres improved into a narrow run between FLOW RIDER and WITHOUT RHYME when WITHOUT RHYME shifted out slightly. When WITHOUT RHYME then shifted back in THUNDER PRINCE was steadied when crowded. Over the concluding stages was held up behind TOP TO SKY which was giving ground. B Avdulla stated that his instructions were to settle the horse where comfortable depending on how it jumped. He said when his mount jumped only fairly it settled back in the field. Trainer J Richards confirmed the instructions issued.
LUCKY DOCTOR (L225): Prior to the running of the event Trainer P C Ng advised that he had instructed C Y Ho to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages to offset the wide barrier. Near the 1000 Metres shifted out and made contact with MR INVINCIBLE. C Y Ho reported that his mount did not appreciate racing on the Happy Valley circuit and lay out throughout the event.
WITHOUT RHYME (L077): Near the 100 Metres was eased when tightened between LUCKY DOCTOR and MR INVINCIBLE, both of which shifted ground slightly. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WATCH LEGEND (L313): Near the 800 Metres was steadied when momentarily crowded by INVICTUS which shifted in when being corrected by its rider. Near the 400 Metres was eased when momentarily crowded between INVICTUS and FORERUNNER which shifted out.
MASK WARRIOR (L518): Lay in in the Home Straight. Near the 150 Metres A Badel dropped his whip.
SWIFT ASCEND (H395): Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
DARYL FLASH (L168): Approaching the 600 Metres commenced to race keenly and was steadied to avoid ELITE GOLF. Over the concluding stages raced tight to the inside of SWIFT ASCEND which shifted in.
SPEEDY SMARTIE (H108): Shifted in shortly after the start and made contact with ELITE GOLF.
JUBILANT WINNER (J346): From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
AURORA PATCH (K097): E C W Wong could offer no excuse for his mount not finishing the race off in the Home Straight. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MIGHTY COMMANDER (J360): The tongue tie was replaced at the Start. In the middle stages raced keenly and approaching the 800 Metres got its head up when being steadied to avoid AURORA PATCH. Approaching the 400 Metres, when racing keenly, shifted out and made contact with ELITE GOLF. C Y Ho reported that when placed under pressure in the Home Straight his mount did not respond to his riding and raced in a disappointing manner. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ELITE GOLF (L023): Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between LUCRATIVE EIGHT and SPEEDY SMARTIE. After being crossed by LEADING AGILITY approaching the 600 Metres raced keenly and was steadied to avoid LEADING AGILITY. Bumped near the 400 Metres. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
POPE CODY (K313): From the 900 Metres commenced a forward move and was obliged to race wide and without cover thereafter. Sent for sampling post-race.
FLYING FORTUNE (L057): The tongue tie was replaced at the Start.
VIOLET STAR (L149): From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
FIVEFORTWO (K381): Raced wide and without cover until near the 700 Metres.
CHINA WIN (K395): Approaching the finish of the event was steadied when crowded between MISTER DAPPER (B Avdulla) which shifted out and SHOOTING TO TOP which was taken in by POPE CODY (A Badel). B Avdulla and A Badel were advised to exercise more care.
RISING PHOENIX (J498): Shortly after the start was crowded by FIVEFORTWO which shifted out. Near the 1000 Metres was bumped by HYMNBOOK which shifted out when racing keenly. Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when positioned close to CHINA WIN.
HYMNBOOK (L238): In the early stages raced keenly and approaching the 1400 Metres was steadied to avoid FLYING FORTUNE for some distance. Near the 1000 Metres shifted out and made contact with RISING PHOENIX. H Bentley advised that the horse raced too keenly during the race and as a result was unable to finish the race off in the Home Straight. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea. Before being allowed to race again, HYMNBOOK will be subjected to an official veterinary examination. Sent for sampling post-race.
FALLON (H219): Kicked a rail in the Parade Ring, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race. Shifted in shortly after the start and was bumped. Shifted out near the 550 Metres and was bumped.
SONIC LINER (L410): Prior to the running of the event Trainer J Richards advised that the horse would be ridden in a conservative manner in the early stages to offset the outside barrier. From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CALL ME MAGNIFIQUE (L339): Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between RISING PHOENIX and FALLON which shifted in. Near the 550 Metres was bumped by FALLON which shifted out. E C W Wong stated that after being crowded shortly after the start his mount settled further back than intended. He said CALL ME MAGNIFIQUE raced keenly throughout the early and middle stages and as a consequence did not run on in the Home Straight. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. Before being allowed to race again, CALL ME MAGNIFIQUE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
PACKING ANGEL (J454): Bumped at the start. Sent for sampling post-race.
SIX PACK (K061): L Ferraris stated that he was instructed to be positive from a wide barrier but not necessarily lead. He said when the early stages were run outside of standard time SIX PACK was able to lead the event without being pressured to do so.
BRAVEFIELD (L513): Shifted in approaching the 1500 Metres and was bumped. Passing the 300 Metres was hampered when bumped by FORTUNATE SON which shifted out. Z Purton reported that his mount, which was having its first race start at Happy Valley, appeared to shy at the shadows on the track near the 1050 Metres and again near the 800 Metres.
HELENE FEELING (H215): E C W Wong stated that the intention was to hold a more forward position. He said HELENE FEELING jumped only fairly and then failed to show sufficient pace in the early stages to hold a more forward position despite being ridden along.
FORTUNATE SON (J446): Jumped only fairly, shifted out and made contact with PACKING ANGEL. Approaching the 1500 Metres was bumped by BRAVEFIELD which shifted in. C Y Ho reported that his mount travelled satisfactorily during the event. He said after making contact with BRAVEFIELD entering the Home Straight his mount finished the race off only fairly thereafter. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. Sent for sampling post-race.
DEFINITIVE (K037): Bumped on jumping. K Teetan stated that his mount responded only fairly to his riding in the Home Straight but could offer no explanation for the horse’s performance. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
AWESOME FLUKE (J050): Lowered its head as the start was being effected and as a result was slow to begin. Before being allowed to race again, AWESOME FLUKE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
ARMOR GOLDEN EAGLE (K566): A Badel reported that his mount was disadvantaged by being obliged to race wide and without cover of the majority of the event. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
NAUTICAL FORCE (L187): From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
